regions.merged_text: I hope you keep well. Many thanks for kind remembrance for Oct. 25th. Thanks be to God for the quite excellent He gives me at 77. Naturally of course my steps are slowing down as to quite to be expected. Next week (10th) my Rev. Brother M. J. Ex- to celebrate his 80th birth-day. Please pray that we be guided so as to please God to the end. Edify - at least in our last days ...
